name: Cross-Process Retrieval Hardening
description: Prove and harden retrieval across process boundaries: dual-key persistence, real-shape parsing, object_store_path fallback.

steps.description: Specify that persist_graph_container writes under BOTH object_store_path (local id) and the container-id key (text convention). Hands on the expected graph files. Doing the write is a code change that needs a build capability that is not registered.
steps.name: dual_key_write

steps.description: Specify that the loader parses the REAL persisted shape (PersistedCodeGraph) and converts, with an object_store_path fallback. Hands on the expected loaded graph.
steps.name: shape_true_load

steps.description: State the cross-process guarantee as a test: a fresh process retrieves the graph non-empty and complete. Hands on the test procedure and pass condition. Running it needs a fresh-process test capability that is not registered.
steps.name: fresh_process_proof
